LOOK: Bright, natural outdoor sunlight, realistic glowing tanned skin tones, subtle lens flare, authentic and completely unstaged summer vacation vlog aesthetic.

STYLE: A casual, intimate 5-second vacation selfie clip. Relaxed and confident. She blinks naturally against the bright light, checks her reflection in the camera, and playfully lifts the lens up.

CHARACTER: A young woman matching the reference image. Deeply tanned glowing skin, brown hair tied back, with tortoiseshell sunglasses resting on top of her head. She wears small gold hoop earrings, a very delicate gold chain necklace, and a bright light-blue bikini top.

SETTING: Outdoors on a bright sunny day. She is resting on a white plastic lounge chair with a light-blue towel draped behind her. A light-colored tiled patio floor is visible in the background.
